snippet.title: Type Her to Sleep - Announcement Trailer!
snippet.description:
Type Her to Sleep is a lofi cozy typing game where your goal is to help our heroine get a good night’s sleep by typing out her thoughts before they escape. Enjoy relaxing tunes, comforting visuals and a dynamic modifier system that ensures every run is unique.

Now with a visual makeover! 

Play the pre-overhaul version here: https://links.skilzent.com/type-sleep-c5194c
